findings.fixHint: Add a stable `data-composition-id` to the entry composition wrapper.

findings.message: Root composition is missing `data-width` or `data-height`.
findings.fixHint: Set numeric `data-width` and `data-height` on the entry composition root.

findings.message: Missing `window.__timelines` registration.
findings.fixHint: Register each composition timeline on `window.__timelines[compositionId]`.

findings.message: <section class="scene" data-start="0"> has no id, so Studio cannot use a stable edit target for its timeline and canvas controls.
findings.fixHint: Add a stable, human-readable id such as id="hero-title" or id="scene-1-card" to every timeline-visible element you want agents or Studio to edit.

findings.message: Inline <script> imperatively controls managed media via play(). HyperFrames must own media play/pause/seek to keep preview, timeline, and renders deterministic.
findings.fixHint: Remove imperative media play/pause/currentTime/muted control. Express timing with data-start/data-duration and media offsets like data-media-start or data-playback-start instead.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 466 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split coherent scenes or layers into separate .html files under compositions/, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.

findings.message: <div> has timing attributes but no class="clip". The runtime still hides it outside its time range, but Studio and the GSAP clip-ownership rules use .clip to recognise a clip, so leaving it off makes the element harder to edit and to lint.
findings.fixHint: Add class="clip" to the element so Studio and the linter can recognise it as a clip.

findings.message: `requestAnimationFrame` runs on wall-clock time, not the GSAP timeline. It will not sync with frame capture and may cause flickering or missed frames during rendering.
findings.fixHint: Use GSAP tweens or onUpdate callbacks instead of requestAnimationFrame for animation logic.

findings.message: <section> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="hookText">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
